profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the software services industry. Skilled in the .NET Framework, C#, Visual Studio, SQL Server, AutoCAD API, and Inventor API. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Electrical And Computer Engineering from The Ohio State University.

positions.title: Part Owner
positions.description: Part owner and brewer at Campfire Brewing.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Gathered requirements, designed architecture, developed, tested, and delivered a multi-million dollar .NET project that allowed a customer to automate their designs in AutoCAD.  This project utilized the AutoCAD API, Inventor API, and Vault API currently written using .NET 4.7.  All pertinent data was stored in a MS SQL Server database on a separate server.  Database was designed and created using the code-first methodology and Entity Framework Core 5.0. Data access from client machine to server used ASP .NET Core Web API.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Analyst
positions.description: Part of a team of developers supporting and upgrading the MBA application.  Application consists of a local desktop version and a web version that runs in any browser.  Data between the two versions is synced using Microsoft’s sync framework.  Instrumental in successfully launching the application to 500+ distributors in the US, Canada, and UK.  Influential in redesigning and rewriting reporting functionality to increase reporting speed by 90% and receipt speed by 95%.  Developed application using VB.NET, C#.NET, .NET 4.5/4.0, WPF, XAML, LINQ, ASP.NET, MFC, MVC, and SQL
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Business Requirements · Databases · Entity Framework · Software Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developing applications that integrate seamlessly with Autodesk products.

Curtain Wall Placement Tool
Lead designer and developer of Revit design automation application for curtain walls in building design.  Customer implemented a new product line in conjunction with Revit layout tools including curtain wall placement and update, curtain wall panel update, and component placement and update tools.  Currently gathering specifications and designing Phase 3.  Developed using C#.NET 4.0, WPF, Revit 2012/2013 API, and LINQ.

Strip Designer
Gathered specifications, designed, and developed an AutoCAD automation tool for microchip design.  Reduced design time from four hours of manual design to a completely automated design of less than sixty seconds.  Client has implemented three phases and continues to request software upgrades.  Customer has stated their micro chip design has become so complicated that they do not think they could design it without our tool.  Developed using C#.NET 3.5, WPF, AutoCAD API, LINQ to XML, and LINQ to Access DB.

Air Handler Designer
Lead designer and developer of Revit design automation application for air delivery units.  Application moved client from manual design to a fully-automated design.  Reduced design time from two hours to less than sixty seconds.  Developed using C#.NET 3.5, WPF, Revit 2010 API, SQL, and LINQ to XML.

Playground Designer
Developer and eventual lead developer of a sales configurator tool for playground design.   Application allowed playground designers to select playground equipment from a tool palette and place the equipment into a dynamic 2-D design environment.  After making the selection, the designer has the ability to view and interact with the playground layout in a 2-D and 3-D environment.  Developed ability to send the final playground design via FTP to the client for final review and conversion into AutoCAD 2-D and 3-D layouts.  Developed using C#.NET 3.0, WPF, LINQ, and ASP.NET.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Business Requirements · Building Information Modeling (BIM) · Databases · Entity Framework · Technical Architecture · Software Development

positions.title: Senior IT Specialist (C/C++)
positions.description:
Tax Audit Software
Part of a development team that wrote specifications, programmed, and debugged a system that tracked IRS audits.  Developed application using Pro*C/C++.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Business Requirements · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Garment Designer
Developer and eventual lead developer of an AutoCAD automation project to design medical fitted garments.  Application gathered measurements and designed a pattern DXF file used in a laser cutting device.  Designers interacted with the pattern in AutoCAD to make adjustments to the final output.  Reduced design time by 50%.  Developed application using C++, Object ARX, SQL, and MFC
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Software Development

positions.title: Controls Engineer
positions.description:
Scroll Compressor Dial Station
Lead programmer on a $1.2 million assembly dial station utilizing an Allen Bradley PLC-5 processor integrating seamlessly with an existing scroll compressor assembly line.  Programmed in V+, the dial station contained three pick and place robots while three automatic screw drivers were controlled by the PLC.
